title: सप्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 7 · Karna's array of the makara

summary.en: Karna, made general, arrays the Kaurava army in the shape of a makara, with himself at its beak. The Pandavas answer with a crescent array and the two armies close for battle.
summary.kn: ಸೇನಾಪತಿಯಾದ ಕರ್ಣ ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮಕರವ್ಯೂಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ತಾನೇ ಅದರ ಕೊಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರು ಅರ್ಧಚಂದ್ರ ವ್ಯೂಹದಿಂದ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: सेनापति बने कर्ण कौरव सेना को मकर-व्यूह में सजाते हैं और स्वयं उसके मुख पर खड़े होते हैं। पाण्डव अर्धचन्द्र व्यूह से उत्तर देते हैं और सेनाएँ युद्ध के लिए भिड़ती हैं।
summary.te: సేనాపతి అయిన కర్ణుడు కౌరవసేనను మకర వ్యూహంగా అమర్చి తానే దాని ముక్కు వద్ద నిలుస్తాడు. పాండవులు అర్ధచంద్ర వ్యూహంతో బదులిస్తారు; సేనలు యుద్ధానికి తలపడతాయి.
summary.ta: தலைவனான கர்ணன் கௌரவப் படையை மகர வியூகத்தில் அமைத்துத் தானே அதன் அலகில் நிற்கிறான். பாண்டவர் பிறை வியூகத்தால் பதிலளிக்க, படைகள் போருக்கு மோதுகின்றன.
summary.ml: സേനാപതിയായ കർണ്ണൻ കൗരവസേനയെ മകരവ്യൂഹത്തിൽ അണിനിരത്തുന്നു; അതിന്റെ കൊക്കിൽ അദ്ദേഹം തന്നെ നിൽക്കുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവർ അർദ്ധചന്ദ്രവ്യൂഹത്തിൽ മറുപടി നൽകുന്നു; രണ്ടു സേനകളും യുദ്ധത്തിനായി അടുക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.7; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
सेनापत्यं तु संप्राप्य कर्णो वैकर्तनस्तदा ।
तथोक्तश्च स्वयं राज्ञा स्निग्धं भ्रातृसमं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Having obtained the generalship, and having been spoken to affectionately by the king himself, in words like a brother's, what did Karna Vaikartana, so wise, do then?

verses.text:
योगमाज्ञाप्य सेनाया आदित्येऽभ्युदिते तदा ।
अकरोत्किं महाप्राज्ञस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, Sanjaya, what he did after ordering the army to be yoked when the sun had risen.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
कर्णस्य मतमाज्ञाय पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ ।
योगमाज्ञापयामास नान्दीतूर्यपुरःसरम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing Karna's wish, your son, O best of Bharatas, ordered the troops yoked, with the auspicious Nandi trumpets leading.

verses.text:
महत्यपररात्रे तु तव पुत्रस्य मारिष ।
योगो योगेति सहसा प्रादुरासीन्महास्वनः ॥

meaning.en: In the last part of the night, my lord, a great cry of "Yoke! Yoke!" suddenly arose from your son's camp.

verses.text:
नागानां कल्पमानानां रथानां च वरूथिनाम् ।
संनह्यतां पदातीनां वाजिनां च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: As elephants were being arrayed, chariots with their armour, foot-soldiers and horses were being equipped, O lord of the people,

verses.text:
क्रोशतां चापि योधानां त्वरितानां परस्परम् ।
बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो दिवस्पृक्सुमहांस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: and as warriors shouted to one another in haste, a great tumult rose up to the sky then.

verses.text:
ततः श्वेतपताकेन बालार्काकारवाजिना ।
हेमपृष्ठेन धनुषा हस्तिकक्ष्येण केतुना ॥

meaning.en: Then the charioteer's son appeared on a chariot with a white banner, horses the colour of the young sun, a golden-backed bow and an elephant-rope standard,

verses.text:
तूणेन शरपूर्णेन साङ्गदेन वरूथिना ।
शतघ्नीकिङ्किणीशक्तिशूलतोमरधारिणा ॥

meaning.en: a quiver full of arrows, with armlets and armour, and bearing hundred-killers, bells, spears, tridents and lances,

verses.text:
कार्मुकेणोपपन्नेन विमलादित्यवर्चसा ।
रथेनातिपताकेन सूतपुत्रो व्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: with a bow fitted to it, shining like the spotless sun, a chariot full of banners.

verses.text:
धमन्तं वारिजं तात हेमजालविभूषितम् ।
विधुन्वानं महच्चापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Dear one, he was seen blowing his conch, adorned with a golden net, shaking his great bow adorned with gold.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा कर्णं महेष्वासं रथस्थं रथिनां वरम् ।
भानुमन्तमिवोद्यन्तं तमो घ्नन्तं सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Karna, great archer and best of chariot-fighters, standing on his chariot like the rising sun destroying the darkness a thousandfold,

verses.text:
न भीष्मव्यसनं केचिन्नापि द्रोणस्य मारिष ।
नान्येषां पुरुषव्याघ्र मेनिरे तत्र कौरवाः ॥

meaning.en: the Kauravas there, O tiger among men, thought nothing of the loss of Bhishma, nor of Drona, nor of the others.

verses.text:
ततस्तु त्वरयन्योधाञ्शङ्खशब्देन मारिष ।
कर्णो निष्कासयामास कौरवाणां वरूथिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, urging on the warriors with the blast of his conch, Karna, great archer, led the Kaurava army out.

verses.text:
व्यूहं व्यूह्य महेष्वासो माकरं शत्रुतापनः ।
प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णः पाण्डवान्विजिगीषया ॥

meaning.en: That great archer and scorcher of enemies drew up the array called the makara and then advanced to meet the Pandavas, wishing victory.

verses.text:
मकरस्य तु तुण्डे वै कर्णो राजन्व्यवस्थितः ।
नेत्राभ्यां शकुनिः शूर उलूकश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: At the mouth of the makara stood Karna, O king; at its two eyes the hero Shakuni and the great chariot-fighter Uluka.

verses.text:
द्रोणपुत्रस्तु शिरसि ग्रीवायां सर्वसोदराः ।
मध्ये दुर्योधनो राजा बलेन महता वृतः ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son was at the head and all the brothers at the neck; in the middle was King Duryodhana, surrounded by a great force.

verses.text:
वामे पादे तु राजेन्द्र कृतवर्मा व्यवस्थितः ।
नारायणबलैर्युक्तो गोपालैर्युद्धदुर्मदः ॥

meaning.en: At the left foot, O king of kings, stood Kritavarman, with the Narayana troops and the cowherds, wild in battle.

verses.text:
पादे तु दक्षिणे राजन्गौतमः सत्यविक्रमः ।
त्रिगर्तैश्च महेष्वासैर्दाक्षिणात्यैश्च संवृतः ॥

meaning.en: At the right foot, O king, stood Gautama of true valour, surrounded by the Trigarta great archers and the southerners.

verses.text:
अनुपादस्तु यो वामस्तत्र शल्यो व्यवस्थितः ।
महत्या सेनया सार्धं मद्रदेशसमुत्थया ॥

meaning.en: At the rear left foot stood Shalya with a great army born of the land of Madra.

verses.text:
दक्षिणे तु महाराज सुषेणः सत्यसंगरः ।
वृतो रथसहस्रैश्च दन्तिनां च शतैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: At the right, great king, was Sushena of true pledge, surrounded by thousands of chariots and hundreds of elephants.

verses.text:
पुच्छे आस्तां महावीरौ भ्रातरौ पार्थिवौ तदा ।
चित्रसेनश्च चित्रश्च महत्या सेनया वृतौ ॥

meaning.en: At the tail were the two heroic royal brothers Chitrasena and Chitra, surrounded by a great army.

verses.text:
ततः प्रयाते राजेन्द्र कर्णे नरवरोत्तमे ।
धनंजयमभिप्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: When Karna, best of the best of men, had set out, Dharmaraja, looking at Dhananjaya, said this.

verses.text:
पश्य पार्थ महासेनां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संयुगे ।
कर्णेन निर्मितां वीर गुप्तां वीरैर्महारथैः ॥

meaning.en: "Look, Partha, at the great army of Dhritarashtra's son, drawn up by Karna in the battle, hero, and guarded by heroic great chariot-fighters.

verses.text:
हतवीरतमा ह्येषा धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः ।
फल्गुशेषा महाबाहो तृणैस्तुल्या मता मम ॥

meaning.en: This great host of Dhritarashtra's son has had its heroes killed and is only a trifling remainder, strong-armed one; I regard it as equal to blades of grass.

verses.text:
एको ह्यत्र महेष्वासः सूतपुत्रो व्यवस्थितः ।
सदेवासुरगन्धर्वैः सकिंनरमहोरगैः ।
चराचरैस्त्रिभिर्लोकैर्योऽजय्यो रथिनां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Only one great archer is posted here, the charioteer's son, who with gods, asuras, gandharvas, kinnaras and great serpents, with the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings, cannot be beaten, best of chariot-fighters.

verses.text:
तं हत्वाद्य महाबाहो विजयस्तव फल्गुन ।
उद्धृतश्च भवेच्छल्यो मम द्वादशवार्षिकः ।
एवं ज्ञात्वा महाबाहो व्यूहं व्यूह यथेच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: If you kill him today, strong-armed Phalguna, the victory is yours, and the thorn of twelve years in my heart will be pulled out. Knowing this, strong-armed one, array your host as you wish."

verses.text:
भ्रातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवः श्वेतवाहनः ।
अर्धचन्द्रेण व्यूहेन प्रत्यव्यूहत तां चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his brother's words, the white-horsed Pandava countered that host with the half-moon array.

verses.text:
वामपार्श्वेऽभवद्राजन्भीमसेनो व्यवस्थितः ।
दक्षिणे च महेष्वासो धृष्टद्युम्नो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: At the left side stood Bhimasena, and at the right the strong great archer Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.text:
मध्ये व्यूहस्य साक्षात्तु पाण्डवः कृष्णसारथिः ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च धर्मराजश्च पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: In the middle of the array was the Pandava himself, with Krishna as charioteer; Nakula, Sahadeva and the king of dharma were behind.

verses.text:
चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ।
नार्जुनं जहतुर्युद्धे पाल्यमानौ किरीटिना ॥

meaning.en: The two Panchalas Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas guarded the wheels; protected by Kiritin, they did not leave Arjuna in the battle.

verses.text:
शेषा नृपतयो वीराः स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः ।
यथाभावं यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं च भारत ॥

meaning.en: The remaining kings and heroes stood in armour in the array, according to their rank, enthusiasm and strength, O Bharata.

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाव्यूहं व्यूह्य भारत पाण्डवाः ।
तावकाश्च महेष्वासा युद्धायैव मनो दधुः ॥

meaning.en: Having thus arrayed this great formation, O Bharata, the Pandavas and your great archers set their minds only on battle.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा व्यूढां तव चमूं सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे ।
निहतान्पाण्डवान्मेने तव पुत्रः सहान्वयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his army arrayed by the charioteer's son in the battle, your son with his kin thought the Pandavas already killed.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवीं सेनां व्यूढां दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रान्हतान्मेने सकर्णान्वै जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Likewise Yudhishthira, seeing the Pandava army arrayed, thought Dhritarashtra's sons with Karna killed, O lord of men.

verses.text:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः ।
सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त सशब्दाश्च समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Then conches, kettledrums, tabors, anakas and cow-horns suddenly sounded on all sides with great noise.

verses.text:
सेनयोरुभयो राजन्प्रावाद्यन्त महास्वनाः ।
सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे शूराणां जयगृद्धिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Great sounds were played in both armies, O king, and the lion-roars of heroes eager for victory arose.

verses.text:
हयहेषितशब्दाश्च वारणानां च बृंहितम् ।
रथनेमिस्वनाश्चोग्राः संबभूवुर्जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: The neighing of horses, the trumpeting of elephants and the fearful rumbling of chariot wheels arose, O lord of the people.

verses.text:
न द्रोणव्यसनं कश्चिज्जानीते भरतर्षभ ।
दृष्ट्वा कर्णं महेष्वासं मुखे व्यूहस्य दंशितम् ॥

meaning.en: No one remembered the loss of Drona, O best of Bharatas, seeing the great archer Karna armoured at the head of the array.

verses.text:
उभे सेने महासत्त्वे प्रहृष्टनरकुञ्जरे ।
योद्धुकामे स्थिते राजन्हन्तुमन्योन्यमञ्जसा ॥

meaning.en: The two armies, full of great strength, with elated men and elephants, stood eager to fight, wishing to kill each other directly.

verses.text:
तत्र यत्तौ सुसंरब्धौ दृष्ट्वान्योन्यं व्यवस्थितौ ।
अनीकमध्ये राजेन्द्र रेजतुः कर्णपाण्डवौ ॥

meaning.en: There, eagerly watchful and highly excited, seeing each other posted, Karna and the Pandava shone in the middle of the armies, O king of kings.

verses.text:
नृत्यमाने तु ते सेने समेयातां परस्परम् ।
तयोः पक्षैः प्रपक्षैश्च निर्जग्मुर्वै युयुत्सवः ॥

meaning.en: The two armies, as though dancing, came together; from their wings and flanks fighters eager for battle burst forth.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं नरवारणवाजिनाम् ।
रथिनां च महाराज अन्योन्यं निघ्नतां दृढम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the battle began, great king, of men, elephants, horses and chariot-fighters, who were striking one another hard.
